title: UTIITSL Documents Required for PAN Card
section: Note 2 (Not more than 3 months old) Depository account 21 - statement(Not more than 3 months old) Credit card 22 - statement(Not more - than 3 months old) For Individuals born on and after 1 st October 23 - 2023 birth certificate issued by the municipal authority or any office  --- Page 3 --- authorised to issue birth and death certificate by the Registrar of Birth and Deaths or the Indian Consulate as defined in clause (d) of sub-section (1) of section 2 of the Citizenship Act, 1955 (57 of 1955); Birth certificate issued by the municipal authority, or any office authorised to issue birth and death certificate by the Registrar of Birth and 24 - - Deaths or the Indian Consulate as defined in clause (d) of sub-section (1) of section 2 of the Citizenship Act, 1955 (57 of 1955) 25 - - Pension payment order Marriage certificate 26 - - issued by the Registrar of Marriages Matriculation certificate 27 - - or mark sheet of recognized board A. Or original of: Certificate of identity signed by a Member of Parliament or Member of Legislative Assembly or Municipal Councilor 1 - - or a Gazetted Officer, as the case may be (Certificate format attached as Annexure- A) Bank certificate, on the letter head from the branch (along with the name, stamp and copy 2 of employee ID of the - - issuing officer) containing duly attested photograph and bank account  --- Page 4 --- number of the applicant. ( Certificate format attached as Annexure-C) Certificate of address signed by a Member of Parliament or Member of Legislative 3 Assembly or - Municipal Councilor or a Gazetted Officer, as the case may be (Certificate format attached as Annexure- A) Employer certificate. ( 4 - Certificate format - attached as Annexure-B) Affidavit sworn before a 5 - - Magistrate stating the date of birth Note 1: In case of a person being a minor, in addition to Aadhaar of the minor, any of the above listed documents of any of the parents or guardian of such minor shall be deemed to be the proof of identity. Note 2: In case of an Indian citizen residing outside India, copy of bank account statement in country of residence or copy of non-resident external bank account statements shall be the proof of address.
